description:
kith-attach/src/lib.rs has several public methods on BlobStore without doc comments:

- BlobStore::new() (line 18)
- BlobStore::init() (line 24)
- BlobStore::generate_blob_id() (line 28)
- BlobStore::validate_blob_id() (line 33)
- BlobStore::blob_path() (line 54)

The struct itself has a doc comment but the individual methods do not. For a storage API these are important to document — particularly validate_blob_id() which has non-obvious rules (max 128 chars, no leading dot, only alphanumeric/-/_).
title: kith-attach public methods missing doc comments
